subject.title: gateway tool not available to external-provider agent sessions

question: Should an explicitly allowlisted `gateway` tool be available to external-provider agent sessions under the existing owner/admin gateway-tool gates, or should it remain restricted to local gateway/webchat-style sessions?
rationale: The source and docs imply explicit `alsoAllow` should work, but the gateway tool can mutate config and restart the process, so exposing it to hosted-provider sessions needs maintainer-confirmed security intent before an automated repair.

options.title: Honor explicit allow with gates
options.body: If live repro confirms the omission, repair the shared effective-tool/provider path so `tools.alsoAllow: ["gateway"]` works only within the existing non-embedded and owner/admin gateway-tool boundaries.

options.title: Keep external-provider restriction
options.body: Document that `gateway` is intentionally local-session-only and make `tools.effective` explain that restriction when `alsoAllow` asks for it.

options.title: Diagnostics before behavior change
options.body: Add a focused unavailable-tool reason for `gateway` first, then decide exposure after maintainers inspect real xAI/Grok evidence.

recommendation.title: Honor explicit allow with gates
recommendation.body: If live repro confirms the omission, repair the shared effective-tool/provider path so `tools.alsoAllow: ["gateway"]` works only within the existing non-embedded and owner/admin gateway-tool boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the gateway tool implementation, config mutation boundary, and `alsoAllow` policy path where this history is most directly connected.
